title: Stored revision registry
responsibility: Projects a revision’s declared units and scenarios with their graph, version identities and reviewed limits.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.manifests
inputs.description: The component manifests stored at this revision; each becomes a unit entry and contributes its declared dependencies to the graph. They are sorted by id, and an empty list yields available: false with a gap.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.scenarios
inputs.description: The scenario manifests stored at this revision; each becomes a scenario entry and its declared unit coverage becomes graph edges. They are sorted by id, and an empty list adds no scenario nodes or coverage edges.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.blobs
inputs.description: Optional map from owned source or documentation paths to blob hashes, used in each unit's version hash. Missing path entries use the marker absent; defaults to new Map() (empty).

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.baselines
inputs.description: Optional map keyed by unit id; each unit's entry is passed to emittedLimits and frozenLimits to determine its optional emitted and limits fields. Defaults to new Map() (empty).

outputs.name: revisionRegistry
outputs.description: Snapshot of the supplied manifests with units and scenarios sorted by id, plus the declared dependency and coverage graph; each unit version is a 16-character SHA-256 prefix of canonical manifest-and-file data. Available is false with a gap when no unit entries exist; optional catalog, emitted and limits fields are included only when present.

examples.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision
